data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 abstracts SRC_005: the economic monoculture argument generalizes beyond market signal synchronization to include any isomorphic selection pressure (regulatory compliance, off-the-shelf solutions, shared training data) that collapses the causal independence of decentralized operators. Refuted if market signal synchronization induces correlated failures through a distinct dynamical mechanism (self-organized criticality) that economic monoculture arguments cannot predict or explain.
